_comment: Seed data for the catalogue. Image files are NOT listed here: each product's images live in temp/products/<slug>/ and are uploaded in filename order, so the numeric prefix (1-, 2-, 3-, 4-) decides which image is primary and which the card crossfades to. Keeping the order in the filenames rather than in this file means the two cannot drift. metaTitle/metaDescription are derived by the seed from name and description rather than stored here, so they cannot go stale when the copy changes.

categories.name: Hoodies
categories.description: Heavyweight layers built for the cooler months.

categories.name: Accessories
categories.description: The pieces that finish a fit.

products.name: Oversized Hooded Sweatshirt
products.description: A heavyweight brushed-cotton hoodie cut deliberately oversized, with a double-layer hood and ribbed cuffs that hold their shape. Unisex fit — size down for a closer cut.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold, inside out. Do not tumble dry. Warm iron on the reverse only.

products.name: Boxy Short-Sleeve T-Shirt
products.description: A boxy, square-cut tee in heavy combed cotton that holds its shape through washing. Drop shoulder, wide body, ribbed neck. Unisex.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold with like colours. Tumble dry low. Do not bleach.

products.name: Zip-Through Track Jacket
products.description: A full-zip track jacket with tonal side panels and a stand collar. Light enough for Cairo evenings, structured enough to hold a shape. Unisex.
products.material: Recycled polyester shell with cotton-blend lining
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold, zip fastened. Hang to dry. Do not iron the panels.

products.name: Wide-Leg Cargo Trousers
products.description: Wide-leg cargos in washed cotton twill, with deep side pockets and a drawcord waist. They break at the ankle rather than pooling. Unisex.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold, inside out. Hang to dry. Warm iron if needed.

products.name: Long-Sleeve Ribbed Thermal
products.description: A close-fitting ribbed thermal that works as a base layer or on its own. Fine gauge, high stretch, holds its shape at the cuff. Unisex.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold. Reshape while damp. Do not tumble dry.

products.name: Canvas Crossbody Bag
products.description: A compact crossbody in heavy waxed canvas with an adjustable webbing strap and a single zipped compartment. Enough for a phone, a wallet and keys.
products.material: Waxed cotton canvas with webbing strap
products.careInstructions: Spot clean only. Do not machine wash — washing strips the wax finish.

products.name: Ribbed Knit Beanie
products.description: A fine-gauge ribbed beanie with a folded cuff. Sits close without gripping.
products.careInstructions: Hand wash cold. Dry flat. Do not wring.

products.name: Relaxed Drawstring Shorts
products.description: Mid-length shorts in the same heavy cotton twill as the cargos, with a drawcord waist and a relaxed leg. Built for the months that matter here. Unisex.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold, inside out. Hang to dry.
